question.text: Interest income received by a REIT from its SPV enjoys pass-through status. Under which section is it exempt at the REIT level?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook page 278, interest income earned by a REIT from an SPV is exempt in the hands of the REIT under Section 10(23FC). Page 282 summarises interest from SPV as exempt under Section 10(23FC)(a). The interest is then taxable in the hands of unit-holders. The Trap: Section 10(23FCA) is the exemption for REIT-level rental income, not interest from SPV. Section 10(23FD) covers narrower unit-holder/other-income exemptions; the workbook uses Section 10(23FC)(b) for dividend from SPV at REIT/InvIT level, not 10(23FD). Section 115BAA is the corporate tax rate provision and is unrelated. Note: Keep these three sections distinct: 10(23FC) for REIT-level interest/dividend from SPV, 10(23FCA) for REIT rental income, and 10(23FD) for the narrower unit-holder/other-income exemptions.
